items: Open rotor housing cold end basket removal door.

Rotate rotor to line up rotor basket removal door with opening in rotor 
 housing.
Remove cover from rotor basket

Remove cold end element baskets the number of cold end basket to be removed 
 and replaced in each sector varies with the size of the air preheater.

A piece of rod or pipe with a hook on one fit slot in basket wrapper and a hook 
 on the other end will be required to remove and replace baskets. Rod or pipe 
 should be long enough to reach inner most basket

Install new baskets starting with inner most baskets, which designated as A 
 basket.
Install sector cover using sealing compound under cover

Rotate rotor to adjacent sector, remove cover and ensure element baskets have 
 been replaced.
Review the thickness of elements in cold end baskets

Hot and / or Intermediate 
Baskets Surface Figure 3,4,5

items:
Hot and/or Intermediate element baskets may be removed from air outlet or gas 
 inlet duct just above air pre heater as to which of these ducts is used 
 depends on duct configuration and access.

Once has been established as to which duct baskets are to be removed . Layout 
 and burn opening in duct of sufficient size to accommodate largest element 
 basket preferred location is center of long side of duct.
Remove hot end radial and circumferential seals.

Install monorail or similar arrangement in line with . and just above . 
 Opening in duct for use of hoist in removing present basket and installing new 
 baskets.
Rotate rotor so that sector lines up with opening and monorail.

Using a two line sling with right angle hooks of material which will slip 
 under basket holding bars. Remove baskets from rotor compartments and transfer 
 to out side of air pre heater .

Install new element baskets. Repeat this procedure until all element baskets 
 have been replaced.
Reapply and set to proper clearances radial and circumferential seals.
Remove hoist and close up opening in duct.

items: The process of Disassembly of the guide bearing maintenance or exchange
Disconnect the drive motor from met work and secure it.
Drain oil from bearing housing and remove the packing (15)
Remove bearing housing cover (3).

Remove bolts which secure locking cap (9) plate lock washers and locking cap 
 (9).

Screw three eye bolts in to tapped holes in top of trunnion sleeve for use in 
 removing the sleeve.

Remove trunnion sleeve (7) with bearing (2) by ail pressure pump. Attaching a 
 block hawk to a tapped hole in the top of trunnion (4) keep tension on 
 the sleeve while apply.

The bearing is secured to the sleeve, comprises a locknut, lock washer and 
 sleeve. To replaced the bearing, bend out ears of lock washer and remove lock 
 nut. Turn the sleeve bottom side up and tab the inner bearing race to remove 
 bearing from sleeve.

sections.text: Adjustment of Rotor Sealing in Cold State

items:
The sealing system are comprised of radial seal, circumferential seal and 
 rotor past seals .
Radial seal figures (6) .

Replace and adjust each radial seal individually according to the following 
 procedure figure (6) .
Shut down the heater and the drive and secure it.

Attach the seal straight-edge to the support channels welded inside the 
 connecting plate.
Set the seal straight-edge to the trailing edge of on existing radial seal.
Then remove the seal.

Install the seal so it touches across the full length of seal straight-edge 
 (Item #3) tighten the inner and outer bolts of each seal section first (Item 
 #4), then tighten the remaining bolts .

Check the seal clearance at both sector plates by referring to seal clearance 
 table 1 adjust the seal return the seal to the straight-edge and reset the 
 straight-edge.
Set the remaining radial seals to the straight-edge.

Replace and adjust each radial seal individually according to the following 
 procedure:
Shut down the air-heater and drive and secure it.
Remove present seals and holding strips.

Install new seal leaves so that the outer leaf overlaps the inner leaf such 
 that the bend slots are not exposed .

Locate seals on sealing angle in accordance with dimensions gives on cearance 
 seal in table 1 the cold end circumferential seal should just contact the 
 sealing angle.

The hot end circumferential seal are to be set the specified clearance from 
 the sealing angle.

If the sealing angles hove grooved by seals the new seals are to be set at 
 specified clearance in grooved.
Remove present seals for rotor.
Install new seals in same location.

sections.text:
Exchange of Toothed Wheel or the Drive 
figure 10

The driving toothed wheel (1) of the rotor or the regenerative air heater with 
worn or damaged teeth must be exchanged. The process is following:

items:
Disconnect the drive motor from network and secure it against incompetent 
 starting.

Dismantle the rotor drive including the bracket from the stator housing with 
 the use of a pulley block.
Draw off the toothed wheel from the gearbox shaft with use of a draw off jig.

Clean the shaft end, lubricate it with graphite and fit on a new toothed wheel 
 on it . Apply slip-on flanges and screws screwed in the tapped hole in the 
 shaft face.
Secure the toothed wheel on the shaft with a washer and screws.

Mount the drive with the bracket back on the stator housing so as to enable 
 the toothed wheel meshing into the rotor pin gearing . the clearance between 
 the toothed wheel foot and the pin of the rotor pin gearing should be 15.5 mm 
 in cold state . Adjust the clearance bey rotor hand turning according to 
 figure 7 along the whole circumference of the pin gearing it should be checked 
 by means of a gauge in several spots of the circumference of rotor pin 
 gearing, the rim of the pin gearing is not accurately circular.
Check the oil charge of the gearbox, if necessary refill exchange to the oil.

Having finished the drive assembly, checked the oil charge and adjusted the 
 rum of the regenerative air heater.

Before the first filling or the bearings or gearboxes with a lubricating 
 charge/ grease or oil / all parts and surfaces being in contact with the 
 lubricant must be cleaned orderly having cleaned the surfaces, wash them with 
 kerosene or with special flushing oil .

Dont use cloth or rage releasing fibers for cleaning the bearings and sliding 
 surfaces during the bearing assembly observe the possibly highest cleanness 
 leave the bearings in the original packing till using them for the assembly.

Apply always the lubricants of the same quality for the sieve lubricating spot 
 if its necessary to apply some other lubricant quality to be settled with 
 special technical service of the lubricant supplier remove first all residues 
 of original lubricant, and wash the whole lubricating space orderly.
